captions.detailed: An airfield-scale advertising blimp featuring a large, beige, cigar-shaped envelope body. Mounted underneath is a rectangular grey cabin gondola, while twin engine nacelles with black propellers are supported on outriggers on either side. The rear features a cruciform tail assembly with movable fins, and a small mooring wheel is positioned under the rear of the cabin. The propellers rotate continuously around their local shafts, the rudder pivots on a vertical hinge, the elevators pivot on horizontal hinges, and the mooring wheel rotates freely on its axle.
captions.instruction: Create an articulated 3D model of an advertising blimp with a large cigar-shaped envelope, an underslung rectangular cabin, twin side-mounted engine nacelles with rotating propellers, a cruciform tail assembly with working rudder and elevators, and a small rotating mooring wheel underneath.
captions.factory: Construct the main envelope by lofting or revolving a curved profile to form the aerodynamic cigar shape. Create the underslung gondola cabin using a box primitive and position it underneath. Build the outriggers using cylinders, attaching them to side engine nacelles modeled with cylinders or revolved shapes, and add thin cylinders for the propeller blades. Create the tail fins by extruding flat profiles, then add separate rudder and elevator surfaces. Finally, attach a small cylinder for the mooring wheel on a support fork, and define joints for the continuous rotation of the propellers and mooring wheel, and revolute joints for the rudder and elevators.
